title: Grilled Sashimi Tacos with Vietnamese Fruit Slaw
description: A fusion of Japanese and Mexican flavors, this dish features fresh sashimi-grade fish, marinated in a sweet and spicy Vietnamese-inspired mixture, served in tacos with a refreshing fruit slaw.

ingredients.name: Sashimi-grade fish (such as tuna or salmon)
ingredients.notes: Fresh and of the highest quality

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, ginger, and honey to make the marinade.
Place the sashimi-grade fish in a shallow dish and pour the marinade over it. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the fish from the marinade and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine cilantro, rice vinegar, carrot, and red cabbage in a bowl and toss to combine.
Cut the cooked fish into small pieces and serve in tacos with the slaw and any desired additional toppings.
Garnish with additional cilantro and serve immediately.
